phase: S3 unified test evaluation + S4 (append-only input record)

metric_and_statistics_rules.test_metric: macro accuracy over ALL SEEN classes of the final task; per-class = mean(argmax == class) on that class's test rows; macro = unweighted mean over classes in canonical ascending order
metric_and_statistics_rules.column_order: canonical seen ascending (0..2t-1); argmax ties -> smallest id
metric_and_statistics_rules.r1_view: D1 identity on the 56-dim joint, saved S2 ridge W/b, float64
metric_and_statistics_rules.r2_view: fixed S2 PCA16 (D3) applied to the joint, saved ridge W/b, float64
metric_and_statistics_rules.primary_contrast: same-seed candidate test macro minus S1 accepted test macro

statistics.main_matrix: 8-seed cells: two-sided paired t95 (df7), NOMINAL interval
statistics.holm_formula: p_adj(i) = min(1, max_{j<=i} [(24 - j + 1) * p_(j)]) over the r cells that actually reached 8 seeds, sorted ascending
statistics.null_rule: cells without 8 seeds: raw and adjusted p are null; no rejection claim
statistics.scope_note: these describe the fixed seed sample only; not population inference

s4.primary_quantity: per-dataset endpoint range_4 mean over 8 seeds vs per-dataset R1 and R2 endpoint test macro paired gain mean over 8 seeds
s4.test: Spearman rho across the 4 datasets with AVERAGE RANKS for ties; constant variable -> rho null, status UNDEFINED_CONSTANT
s4.hypothesis: higher sensitivity tends to co-occur with larger readout-candidate gain (EXPLORATORY, descriptive)
forbidden: mixing R2-R1 into the 24-item confirmatory family

statistics.baseline_A_gate: reported per its original registered definition, with the multiple-comparison correction listed alongside

metric_and_statistics_rules.three_seed_rule: SCREEN_FAIL cells keep 3-seed descriptive values only; ci95 / raw p / adjusted p are null; no zero fill

append_only: this plan is never rewritten; post-run state is recorded in evaluation_phase_verify_post.json
test_forwards_definition: one increment per candidate/dataset/seed evaluation call; NOT an encoder-batch count
